briefings.headline: Hunt the fastball; stay disciplined on the slider
briefings.message: Jesse Scholtens is the high-confidence predicted starter (85%), but his results—especially against right-handed hitters—come from small samples. Righties: look to damage the fastball; Dane Myers, Tyler Stephenson, and Sal Stewart have favorable matchup edges. Stay disciplined against Scholtens’ slider, his most-used pitch. Be ready to adjust if his mix or command changes. Tampa Bay’s rested bullpen arms to watch are Bryan Baker, Hunter Bigge, Kevin Kelly, and Griffin Jax.
reminders: Righties, hunt fastballs and avoid chasing breaking balls.
Adjust if the predicted starter or his approach changes.

briefings.headline: Lowder sets the tone; vary speeds and locations
briefings.message: Rhett Lowder starts as the only ready option, with a 90-pitch limit and a target of five innings. His matchup favors him against Junior Caminero and Yandy Díaz, but the left-handed split sample is small. Change speeds and locations against lefties, especially Jonathan Aranda and Richie Palacios; Palacios’ matchup sample is small. Keep fastballs out of Caminero’s zone and work sliders off the plate. Use fresh leverage arms first; Graham Ashcraft, Emilio Pagán, Connor Phillips, and Kyle Nicolas are limited after pitching yesterday. Reserve Pagán for necessity in a save situation.
reminders: Change speeds and keep pitches down against left-handed hitters.
Avoid fastballs in the zone to Caminero.
Use fresh bullpen leverage arms before limited relievers.

briefings.headline: Execute the approved plan and protect workload
briefings.message: Start Rhett Lowder with a 90-pitch ceiling and target of five innings. The lineup targets the high-confidence Jesse Scholtens prediction (85%): right-handed hitters hunt fastballs and stay disciplined against the slider. Keep Sal Stewart and Eugenio Suárez in despite rest suggestions; both have meaningful matchup edges. Preserve fresh bullpen leverage arms and keep limited relievers available only if needed, with Pagán reserved for necessity in a save situation. Jose Trevino, Nick Lodolo, Caleb Ferguson, and Hunter Greene are out.
